विद्यार्थियों को ऐसा दृष्टिकोण प्रदान करना कि वे नवाचार में अग्रणी बनें, प्रमुख प्रौद्योगिकियों का निर्माण एवं उपयोग करें जो भविष्य की दुनिया को बदल दें, और हमारे व्यवसायों तथा समाज की समस्याओं का समाधान ढूंढें।
छात्रों को विश्व स्तरीय शिक्षा प्रदान करना ताकि वे गहन तकनीकी ज्ञान (नई प्रौद्योगिकियों सहित), रचनात्मकता, सामाजिक जागरूकता, उद्यमिता कौशल और आजीवन सीखने में उत्कृष्टता प्राप्त करें।
जिज्ञासा-प्रेरित और समस्या-आधारित शोध करना जो परिवर्तनकारी विचार उत्पन्न करे जो हमारे समाज और हमारी दुनिया को बेहतर बनाएँ।
ऐसे शिक्षकों को शामिल करना और विकसित करना जो अगली पीढ़ी को शिक्षित करने तथा शिक्षा, शोध और संस्कृति में उच्च मानक सुनिश्चित करने के लिए जिम्मेदार हों।

To create leaders who will be at the forefront of innovation, creating and applying pivotal technologies that will transform the world of tomorrow, and seek solutions to problems of our businesses and our society.
To deliver world-class education to students so that they excel in deep technical know-how including new technologies, creativity, social awareness, entrepreneurial skills, and lifelong learning.

To engage and develop educators who are responsible for educating the next generation and ensuring high standards in education, research, and culture.

The department offers programs including BTech in CSE, AI, IT, and CSE (Cyber Security), M.Tech. in CSE (Data Science/AI), MCA, B.Sc. (online) in CS/AI&ML/DSA, and focuses on building strong fundamentals in computing. It emphasizes emerging areas such as AI, cybersecurity, data science, and computer vision, supported by modern labs and active research initiatives. The department aims to develop skilled professionals with strong technical expertise and practical problem-solving abilities.

The department offers a BTech in ECE, M.Tech. in ECE (VLSI/Chip Design & ML/AI & Communication), and focuses on building strong foundations along with specializations in areas like VLSI Design and Artificial Intelligence. It has active research groups in VLSI, embedded systems, nanoelectronics, IoT, AI/ML, microwave, and signal processing, supported by state-of-the-art facilities and experienced faculty. The department promotes interdisciplinary research and innovation with strong academic and industry engagement. Overall, the department aims to foster research-driven learning and develop skilled professionals prepared to contribute to emerging technologies and national initiatives like Viksit Bharat @2047.

t is an interdisciplinary center focusing on the intersection of technology, language, and society, with emphasis on areas such as AI, multilingualism, and digital cultures. The department covers diverse fields including linguistics, digital humanities, literature, economics, and environmental studies, supported by modern labs and experiential learning tools. It aims to foster critical thinking, innovation, and socially impactful research, preparing students to address global challenges responsibly.

The department offers a BTech in Mathematics and Computing, focusing on building strong foundations in mathematics and computational techniques. It integrates analytical rigor with modern computing approaches and emphasizes areas such as data science, optimization, cryptography, and computational mathematics. Supported by active research and modern resources, the department aims to develop professionals with strong mathematical insight, algorithmic thinking, and advanced problem-solving abilities.

The department offers a BTech in Applied Physics and Computing, focusing on strong foundations in physics integrated with modern computational techniques. It emphasizes emerging areas such as materials science, photonics, quantum technologies, and scientific computing. Supported by modern laboratories and active research initiatives, the department aims to develop professionals with strong analytical skills, scientific understanding, and problem-solving abilities suited for interdisciplinary and technology-driven domains.
